D: A shy electronics store worker is pushed by his workmates into finally getting out there at 40.
P: Serve the snacks when Andy makes his famous egg salad sandwich.
S: Andy's careful egg salad sandwich routine
Creamy egg salad on soft white bread, made carefully, exactly the way Andy does it every day.
Chips, salsa and peanuts on the poker table. Tip 200g corn chips into a bowl with 1 jar salsa beside it and a bowl of 200g salted peanuts.
M: dinner at Trish's with the kids
Roast chicken with vegetables, the family dinner at Trish's. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with butter, salt and lemon and roast at 200C for 1 hour 15 minutes.
W: Rich chocolate truffles rolled in cocoa, a little date-night sweet. Melt 200g dark chocolate into 120ml hot cream and chill until firm.
K: Ice-cold milk in a tall glass, to go with the egg salad.

s.note: Andy's careful egg salad sandwich routine
s.how: Boil 6 eggs for 10 minutes, cool, peel and mash with 4 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tsp mustard, salt and pepper. Spread over 4 slices of bread, top with 4 more and cut into triangles.
Tip 200g corn chips into a bowl with 1 jar salsa beside it and a bowl of 200g salted peanuts. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: dinner at Trish's with the kids
m.how: Rub a 1.8kg chicken with butter, salt and lemon and roast at 200C for 1 hour 15 minutes. Roast 800g potatoes and 3 carrots alongside.

w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate into 120ml hot cream and chill until firm. Roll into 20 balls and dust in 30g cocoa. Serve it at the halfway point of the film.

d.how: Pour 1L cold full cream milk into 4 tall glasses. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold. Keep a second round ready for the back half of the film.
